newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers steady.

Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 900 slaughter steers and 900 heifers; 93,400 head confirmed for the week to date including 20,400 formulated cattle and 1,000 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week. Note all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs
Wk to date: 93,400 Week Ago: 131,700 Year Ago: 85,500
